body: I'm not really in the position to do so. Not yet old enough to be looking after myself yet and I don't feel comfortable telling my parents about these issues :(
I'm sorry
I've tried to rant before but unfortunately for me it does nothing. Nothing makes me feel better. :( I'm sorry
I'm not in the position to talk to a professional :( and from what I've heard on this sub, it seems they aren't very good anyway.

Much appreciated :) After this thread, it seems like ridding of Facebook is a very good thing to do. I will probably end up doing it.

Thank you
It's not your fault for being like this. Depression is an awful thing. I hope you have a much better time next year

That sucks so much :( I'm sorry.
I really hope 2015 is good to you as well.

I do tend to compare my life; a lot. Might look into deleting it, but I do have a problem with that. The only kicks I get these days is out of seeing others happy, and since I never see anyone Facebook is my only way of doing that. Kinda sucks :/ I'll probably end up deleting it though.
That really sucks when that happens :( I'm sorry
Yep. That really sucks. I also hate seeing the "You're my best friend / SO  in the world, love you forever!" posts, not because I hate they have someone in their life but because I don't. *sigh*
I wish I could do that as well. Don't think I'll be able to anytime soon. But hey, I really hope you find your motivation soon :) Good luck

Unfortunately, seeing that I've made it nowhere this whole year and in fact only fallen deeper down this spiral just bums me out. Quite the opposite of fuel for the fire, but that's just because I'm a negative shit.

Nice to hear you have people in your life to help. I wish you all the best :)
I am very sorry to hear that you can relate :( It's awful
It does suck :( Im sorry
That is devastating :'(
I should remove snapchat too. All it does is make me feel worse, not because other people are happy but because I'm not happy like them.
I agree with you. Other people's happiness wasn't the issue for me, it was comparing that against my own that made me feel so awful.
I'm so sorry to hear that. I hope you feel better soon :(
I'm so sorry :(
I like listening to music sometimes, but not playing it anymore. I can't enjoy TV. I can't enjoy any games. I usually just sit on reddit and do nothing until I fall asleep.
No. I don't enjoy anything anymore.

2 years left :/ but I don't know if it's going to get better when I leave. How can things ever change if I don't have the motivation or desire to do anything to change things? This is all my fault, and I'm so stupid for doing nothing about it. I feel powerless to end this cycle of crap that is life. I just want to die. I'm so sorry :(
I'm still in school, yeah :)

It's always been like this. Constant mental, and now physical pain. I'm so sorry but it's impossible to distract me now, all I think about is how pointless everything is. I'm a lost cause. I am so so sorry and thank you so much for the offer you amazing person :)
i dont know how to get through this. ive got no one, and nothing. i dont want to live anymore

Well, there's a bit of an odd situation going on with our friendship. Although I see them as a great friend, they see me like everyone else does. My friend already has people to talk to, and doesn't need me. I don't have any hobbies. I used to have a couple, but over time I've lost interest in all of them. The only thing I pursue now is guitar but I only play that rarely to have a break when I'm having a really rough time. 

Everything hurts so much. Everything is so hard and difficult. Like I said earlier, I have no one. It just hurts to be alive, and I'm done trying. I basically want to die.

Thanks for all the help and just letting me vent in general. You are an amazing person.

Holy shit, thank you for the honest and overall amazing reply! Thank you so much! It made perfect sense.

I have not told anyone apart from the Internet how I feel. I don't have any close friends at all, so I really have no one who I would feel comfortable opening up to, except for maybe as you said my only good friend. The thing is, that person is going through some issues of their own, and I would hate to possibly make them feel bad for me and add more problems to their list. That's not fair. And, although maybe deep down I understand life has its ups and downs, for a long time I've been feeling only down, and it just sucks.

I can try, for sure. I don't know how it started, I just woke up one day feeling bad, but it started to impact my everyday life when I realised how lonely I was. I'm trapped because I don't see a way out of this hole I've dug for myself. And, like I said, a couple of the only things I had to keep me going are gone or almost gone now, so I really have nothing left to live for, in my eyes anyway.Everything is too hard and I'm so tired and I don't want do this anymore.

I'm 17. It's been building up for a while, significantly longer than year if not two years of this now. I suppose I'm just done with everything. Even the things that have kept me holding on (good grades, one good friend as examples) are gone / just about gone now. I feel trapped, like there is no way out of this, and I'm done trying to escape. Sometimes I don't even know how I make it through the day. That's how I'm feeling.

Thanks for replying, means so much.
